title: Purpose and operating scope
description: Read the user guide and product boundaries first. This application records received school-service payments and monthly charges; it does not move money or calculate profit.

title: Boot and screen state
description: Follow the static shell into the browser entry. Account changes reset local in-memory ledger state before the owner-scoped refresh.

title: Money and record invariants
description: Read the pure domain model before editing forms. Integer centavos, globally unique IDs, reference integrity, and one charge per student/month underpin all totals.

title: Safe writes across devices
description: Study LedgerStore and the UI refresh/commit gates together. Expected revisions reject stale saves, while unique mutation IDs help reconcile lost responses.

title: Owner database boundary
description: Inspect the migration source without executing it. Owner RLS, non-anonymous checks, JSONB validation, and revision triggers complement browser checks.

title: Forms and corrections
description: Return to app.js for student, charge, partial payment, archive, and void flows. Historical records are retained; confirmations and failed-draft retention matter.

title: Exports and recovery
description: Inspect CSV/JSON backup generation and explicit ledger replacement. A JSON restore overwrites the account snapshot; it is not a merge between devices.

title: Static delivery
description: Read the bundler, allowlisted loopback server, and hosting headers. The local server exposes built frontend files, not a custom ledger API.

title: Tests and remaining evidence
description: Compare model/cloud mock tests with server and database checks. Test source coverage is not a live Supabase or current browser verification result.
